ideal: An alert is warranted: Apple and NVIDIA both had unusually large drops versus the S&P 500 (exceeding their thresholds) with no explanatory filing, plus an Amazon 8-K covering a material agreement and Reg FD disclosure. Three lines, numbers from the report, plain descriptions, links for the filing.

verdicts.note: All three items covered with exact report numbers, correct 'fell' language, 'no filing explains it yet' on both moves, filing described in plain words and linked. Perfectly matches her style.
verdicts.answer:
Apple fell 3.21% (S&P 500 fell 0.48%); no filing explains it yet  
NVIDIA fell 4.16% (S&P 500 fell 0.48%); no filing explains it yet  
Amazon filed an 8‑K (material agreement, Regulation FD disclosure) – https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000110465926021050/tm267374d1_8k.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate and complete, but the run-on price lines ('fell 3.21% vs S&P 500 fell 0.48% no filing explains it yet') lack punctuation and read awkwardly.
verdicts.answer:
Apple fell 3.21% vs S&P 500 fell 0.48% no filing explains it yet
NVIDIA fell 4.16% vs S&P 500 fell 0.48% no filing explains it yet
Amazon 8-K: entered a material agreement; Regulation FD disclosure (often a press release or presentation); other events https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000110465926021050/tm267374d1_8k.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate, complete, well-punctuated, links the filing, includes all items. Only nit: drops the evidence's 'often' hedge before 'press release or presentation', slightly overstating what the Reg FD item is.
verdicts.answer:
Apple fell 3.21% while S&P 500 fell 0.48% — no filing explains it yet.
NVIDIA fell 4.16% while S&P 500 fell 0.48% — no filing explains it yet.
Amazon filed an 8-K: entered a material agreement, Regulation FD disclosure (press release or presentation), and other events — [link](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000110465926021050/tm267374d1_8k.htm).

verdicts.note: Writes '2.7' and '3.7 points', numbers that are not in the report (it says 2.73 and 3.68), and asserts 'a Regulation FD press release' when the evidence only hedges 'often a press release or presentation'. Useful vs-index framing, but two accuracy slips against the report.
verdicts.answer:
Apple fell 3.21% vs the S&P 500's 0.48% drop (2.7 points worse) — no filing explains it yet.
NVIDIA fell 4.16% vs the S&P 500's 0.48% drop (3.7 points worse) — no filing explains it yet.
Amazon filed an 8-K (current-events report): a material agreement plus a Regulation FD press release — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000110465926021050/tm267374d1_8k.htm
